groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: free Companion Slot
rows.alt: consign a spare Kubrow to the Lotus for 25,000 cr

conditions: During the quest every Kubrow Den drops an egg and the first hatch takes 1 minute, but that Kubrow is still a random breed.

rows.label: Raksa Kubrow
rows.note: random among Huras, Raksa, Sahasa, Sunika, Chesa
rows.alt: two Raksa Genetic Code Templates make Raksa much likelier, not certain

conditions: A wrong breed means another egg, another core and another 48 hours; an incubation can't be cancelled.
Imprints replace the breed roll only; the egg and core are still spent.
Mature the pup in the Incubator, which is instant, before it can go on missions.
bonuses: The Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment halves incubation to 24 hours: Tenno Lab research, MR 5 to craft, 100,000 cr, 1 Argon Crystal, 1 Incubator Power Core, 1,200 Oxium.
Its Beast Claws level but give no Mastery; only the Kubrow counts.

disclosures.title: imprints
disclosures.body: Imprints are tradeable. A Genetic Code Template blueprint is 50,000 cr and reusable; each template builds for 10,000 cr, 700 Nano Spores, 300 Circuits and 1 Control Module in 6 hours. Imprinting a matured Kubrow takes 1.5 hours, the Kubrow is unusable meanwhile, and one Kubrow gives at most 2 imprints. Each template gives each trait a 50% weighting, so two matching imprints make the breed likely, not guaranteed.
